correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs all closures from residual derangement matchings. The Hall lemma with a partial forbidden diagonal matching plus any one further cell proves all m>=3 cells avoidable; m=2 and m=1 are enumerated exhaustively. Inclusion-exclusion counts proper closed matching strata. Pair-atom top joins reconstruct the line graph of K_{n,n} minus a perfect matching, giving full lattice automorphisms, and a complete sound Horn basis plus an n−2 minimal nonclosed premise prove optimal arity. A standalone independent brute-force closure construction verifies n=3..7, without treating finite checks as proof of the general statement.

value.rationale: The derangement context is a canonical finite formalization of all-different with forbidden fixed points. The n−2 unmatched-hole boundary gives an exact structural classification of a natural infinite family, sharp logical implication-complexity invariant, and full order-automorphism group. These precise logical and symmetry invariants are not contained in the classical partial-derangement numerical tables, and matter for Horn representations and lattice reconstruction.
